text: Scaffold a new agent project with a single CLI command
quote: Mastra is a TypeScript framework for building AI agents and applications. Create your first agent with a single command and start building.

text: Route requests to 40+ model providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, etc.) through one interface
quote: Model routing: Connect to 40+ providers through one standard interface. Use models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and more.

text: Build autonomous agents that reason about goals, choose tools, and iterate to a final answer
quote: Build autonomous agents that use LLMs and tools to solve open-ended tasks. Agents reason about goals, decide which tools to use, and iterate internally until the model emits a final answer or an optional stopping condition is met.

text: Graph-based workflow engine with .then/.branch/.parallel control flow for multi-step processes
quote: use Mastra's graph-based workflow engine to orchestrate complex multi-step processes. Mastra workflows use an intuitive syntax for control flow (`.then()`, `.branch()`, `.parallel()`).

text: Suspend an agent or workflow and resume later from persisted execution state after user input/approval
quote: Suspend an agent or workflow and await user input or approval before resuming. Mastra uses storage to remember execution state, so you can pause indefinitely and resume where you left off.

text: Define custom tools with createTool using id, description, input/output zod schemas, and execute function
quote: Import `createTool` from `@mastra/core/tools` and define a tool with an `id`, `description`, `inputSchema`, `outputSchema`, and `execute` function.

text: Load tools from remote MCP servers to extend an agent's capabilities
quote: You can also load tools from remote MCP servers to expand an agent's capabilities.

text: Agent memory persists user messages, replies, and tool results across interactions
quote: Memory enables your agent to remember user messages and agent replies, and tool results across interactions, giving it the context it needs to stay consistent, maintain conversation flow, plus produce better answers over time.

text: Share a single conversation thread across multiple users
quote: Multi-user threads: Share one thread between multiple users.

text: Stream real-time, incremental output from agents and workflows as it's generated
quote: Mastra supports real-time, incremental responses from agents and workflows, allowing users to see output as it's generated instead of waiting for completion.

text: Live evaluations automatically score agent/workflow outputs in real time
quote: Live evaluations allow you to automatically score AI outputs in real-time as your agents and workflows operate.

text: Observability system provides visibility into every agent run, workflow step, tool call, and model interaction
quote: Mastra's observability system gives you visibility into every agent run, workflow step, tool call, and model interaction.

text: Runs on Node.js, Bun, Deno, and Cloudflare runtime environments
quote: Mastra can run against any of these runtime environments: - Node.js `v22.13.0` or later - Bun - Deno - Cloudflare

text: Official MCP docs server package gives AI coding tools direct local access to Mastra's documentation
quote: The `@mastra/mcp-docs-server` package provides direct local access to Mastra's full documentation via the Model Context Protocol (MCP). It works with Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, Claude Code, VS Code, Codex or any tool that supports MCP.

text: Self-host Mastra projects for free under Apache 2.0 license
quote: Self host your Mastra projects ... Free Apache 2.0 licensed $0/ month ... Build and host agents anywhere

text: Pause a workflow at any step to collect data, wait on API callbacks, throttle costly ops, or get human-in-the-loop input
quote: Pause a workflow at any step to collect additional data, wait for an API callback, throttle a costly operation, or request human-in-the-loop input.

text: Tools must be defined via createTool with typed schema and execute function, enforcing type safety
quote: tools MUST be defined via `createTool()` with `id`, `description`, `inputSchema` (zod), `execute()`

text: Workflows let you define structured multi-step task sequences instead of relying on agent reasoning alone
quote: Workflows let you define complex task sequences with clear, structured steps instead of relying on one agent to reason through the entire process.

text: Deploy Mastra applications to any Node.js-compatible environment, self-hosted or as a server
quote: Mastra applications can be deployed to any Node.js-compatible environment. You can deploy a Mastra server or integrate with an existing web framework.

text: Author Model Context Protocol servers exposing agents, tools, and resources via MCP
quote: Author Model Context Protocol servers, exposing agents, tools, and other structured resources via the MCP interface.

text: Compose workflow steps with createWorkflow to define execution flow
quote: Composing **steps** with `createWorkflow` to define the execution flow.

text: Scorers provide quantifiable metrics for measuring agent quality
quote: Scorers help bridge this gap by providing quantifiable metrics for measuring agent quality.

text: Enterprise access controls including RBAC, SSO, IAM, and network policy integration
quote: Enterprise controls RBAC, SSO, IAM, and network policy integration.

text: Convert Mastra streams and stored messages to AI SDK-compatible formats via toAISdkStream/toAISdkMessages
quote: Use `toAISdkStream()` and `toAISdkMessages()` to convert Mastra streams and stored messages to AI SDK-compatible formats.

text: Mastra packages ship embedded docs in dist/docs so an AI agent can read package APIs directly from node_modules
quote: Mastra packages come with embedded documentation in `dist/docs`. When you install a Mastra package, your AI agent can read these files directly from `node_modules` to understand the package's APIs and patterns.
